---
title: "Research"
---

## Elemental pathology and BioLIBS

Tissue elemental imaging using laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS), with applications to environmental and occupational exposure, interstitial lung diseases, cancer and biomaterials.

## Metals and health

Research on elemental signatures, metals and particles in human tissues, integrating analytical chemistry, pathology, environmental health and clinical questions.

## Cancer sciences

Translational research in tumor biology, theranostics and innovative imaging approaches.

## Clinical translation

Development of clinically relevant workflows, from archived tissue analysis and method validation to prospective clinical studies.

> This page will later become the central gateway to detailed pages on BioLIBS, clinical studies, cancer research and collaborations.
